notes: A193550.A193550_conjecture: exists B in Z[[x]], B(0)=1, mk a = 1 + X*B^2, with a n the x^n coefficient of the depth-(n+1) truncation of the continued fraction (a_eq_deeper: same for deeper truncations). Route: all partial numerators are 1 mod 4, so a(n) = Catalan(n) mod 4 and (A-1)/x = C^2 + 4H; sqrt(1+4y) integral via W + W^2 = y solved by x-adic iteration; B = C(1+2W). Holds for any S-fraction with all numerators 1 mod 4. Outside Lean: none (agreement with the b-file checked by certificate/check.py for n <= 240).

sources.what: conjecture, checked to 500 terms, no proof

sources.cite: N. Heninger, E. M. Rains, N. J. A. Sloane, On the integrality of n-th roots of generating functions, arXiv:math/0509316
sources.what: general integrality criteria for roots of series (method background)

prior_art.note: No proof found; the mod-4 reduction to the Catalan continued fraction is ours.
